fill_trainval_infos: build a python module to create train and val info dicts with lidar sweeps and annotations from a NuScenes dataset
get_available_scenes: create a function that filters and returns only NuScenes scenes with valid existing LiDAR data files
get_sample_data: build a python module to retrieve the data path, 3D boxes, and camera intrinsics for a given NuScenes sample_data token
transform_det_annos_to_nusc_annos: create a function that converts detection annotations into the NuScenes evaluation submission JSON format with attributes
format_nuscene_results: summarize the NuScenes detection metrics including per-class AP, TP errors, mAP, and NDS into a formatted report string
